sections.content: Design and query a real schema end-to-end: pick a domain (library, gym, food delivery), write CREATE TABLEs with PKs/FKs/constraints, seed realistic data, then solve 10 analytical queries using JOINs, aggregates, subqueries, and window functions.
Deliverables: schema.sql, seed.sql, queries.sql with comments explaining each result. Every query must return correct, verified output.
Key points: normalize first, add indexes after measuring, document assumptions, and test edge cases (empty tables, NULLs, duplicates).
